objective: Create a differentiated emotional platform for a payment brand.
businessContext: A functional payment category required an ownable emotional idea that could travel across markets.
strategy: Contrast purchasable items with meaningful experiences that money cannot buy.
outcomes: Mastercard maintained and expanded the platform for at least 25 years.
whatWorked: A repeatable narrative structure combined global consistency with local adaptation.
The idea expanded from communications into experiences.
whatFailed: Longevity does not independently prove incremental business effect.
transferConditions: The platform is ownable, flexible across cultures and can extend into customer experience.
nonTransferConditions: Do not treat a reusable tagline alone as a durable platform.

sources.title: Marking 25 years of Priceless
sources.methodology: First-party account of launch, longevity and platform evolution.
